authorizationBoundary.continuousDevelopmentAuthorization: The 2026-08-14 W1-W8 authorization permits safe implementation work subject to every dependency and safety gate
authorizationBoundary.rule: development authorization is never interpreted as approval to publish, mutate a real tenant, enable production flags, or execute provider side effects
requiredApprovalBinding: exact release candidate identity and evidence ledger
approved capability rollout scope and tenant or audience
rollout window stop conditions and rollback owner

capabilityDecisionModel.rule: readiness is decided per capability and risk tier; an aggregate label cannot hide a blocked external action or an unknown evidence column
capabilityDecisionModel.notApplicableRule: NOT_APPLICABLE requires scope, rationale, owner, approver and release-bound evidence
capabilityDecisionModel.unknownRule: missing, stale, mixed-revision or unverifiable evidence is BLOCKED, never READY
capabilityDecisionModel.promotionRule: a capability may be promoted only through its approved canary stages and never because another capability is READY

releaseDecisionRecord: capability-by-capability READY BLOCKED or NOT_APPLICABLE matrix
open incidents vulnerabilities unknown backlog and residual risks
maker checker approvers and explicit GO or NO_GO rationale
rollout cohorts Feature Flag plan observation windows and stop conditions
rollback fail-forward compensation data-recovery and owner contacts
communication support audit and post-release verification plan
goConditions: W8-11 cumulative gate is GREEN for the same immutable candidate
all in-scope high-risk capabilities are READY and critical or high blockers are zero
real positive tenant and negative isolation evidence are current without cross-tenant or secret exposure
external providers accounts budgets licenses policies and kill controls are operationally verified
release-specific approval is present and its scope exactly matches the candidate and rollout plan
rollback or fail-forward and incident response have named owners and current drill evidence
automaticNoGo: candidate drift or dirty unbound generated artifacts
unknown external action outcome unreconciled above the approved risk boundary
tenant isolation security secret PII license or policy violation
missing release-specific approval or approval scope mismatch
unavailable kill rollback restore on-call or canonical authority readback
postDecisionRules: GO authorizes only the exact scope and stages recorded; it is not blanket authority
each rollout stage rereads canonical authority gates and may fail closed
NO_GO preserves artifacts and receipts and records the next admissible remediation action
approval expiry revocation candidate drift or new critical evidence invalidates GO
post-release verification records customer impact usage effect reconcile age and rollback disposition separately

reviewRounds.finding: A single platform-level readiness label could hide blocked external effects
reviewRounds.remediation: made readiness capability- and risk-tier-specific with explicit BLOCKED and NOT_APPLICABLE semantics

reviewRounds.finding: Continuous implementation authorization could be mistaken for release approval
reviewRounds.remediation: separated authorization types and required candidate-bound maker-checker approval plus expiry and stop conditions

tests.reason: W8-11 and release-specific approval are absent; executing release operations would cross explicit safety and external-effect gates
